comments.author: Bob Bergman
comments.text: ice-pirates camera patterns (2026-10-12, built and playtested). Code: ice-pirates src/view/camera.ts (follow/fit/view/toWorld/toScreen), src/app/focus.ts (cameraTarget, AimLead), src/app/game.ts (frame order), src/view/camera.test.ts (headless 600-frame two-threat framing test; Pixi type-only import). Points: (1) a pure target function {x,y,zoom,frame[]} kept separate from easing; position damp 4/s, zoom damp 1.6/s, zoom eased slower on purpose. (2) Screen-relative zoom: clamp(min(w,h*1.6)/1440,0.6,1.4), with userZoom multiplied on top (0.45-1.8). (3) Combat framing: every hostile within 1.15x gun range is a frame point; fit = min((w/2-120)/(|dx|+40),(h/2-150)/(|dy|+40)); zoom = min(desired, fit); floor sized from the LONGEST range on the SMALLEST window (0.4, not 0.8); focus leans 30% to the nearest threat. Pitfalls: framing only the nearest threat; fit caps zoom from above only. Pairs with the fair-fire sim rule (bead d0w). (4) Aim lead clamp((aim-ship)*0.15,+-110), on its own damp 1.6/s; frozen when paused or when the pointer leaves the window (pointerleave on documentElement), unless the last device is the pad. (5) Shake only in apply() as a screen offset: cap 14 px, damp 9/s, slider-scaled, 0 under reduced motion. (6) view() {x,y,hw,hh} feeds fair fire and culling; toScreen is used by the compass. Not built yet: a base-zoom setting, heading-follow (rotate the compass and edge arrows with it; the fair-fire view becomes an oriented box or its bounding box), and exposed spring controls; mine redshifted for these.

title: bd dolt push fails (No user exists for uid 502); embedded DB re-imports JSONL into an empty database on every bd call
description: Seen 2026-10-12 closing epic g1l. Every bd invocation prints 'auto-importing ... into empty database', so local Dolt state doesn't persist between calls; a close can be silently reverted by the next call's import (g1l had to be closed twice). bd dolt push to origin git+ssh fails with 'No user exists for uid 502' both sandboxed and unsandboxed, although git push over the same ssh remote works and ssh-add has the key. Close when: bd show reflects a mutation across calls without re-import, and bd dolt push succeeds.
notes:
2026-10-24 workaround: a mutation sticks only when its own call writes the export, and auto-export runs at most once per 60s, so a run of separate bd close calls loses all but the first. Do the mutations in ONE bd invocation (bd close --force --reason ... id1 id2 ...) and re-read with bd show to confirm.
2026-10-24 likely cause of the reverts: auto-export's git add fails ('paths are ignored by one of your .gitignore files: .beads'), so .beads/issues.jsonl stops being rewritten, and the next auto-import loads the stale file over the Dolt server's newer state. Workaround: after any mutation run bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl explicitly, then confirm with bd show.
Confirmed: .gitignore line 6 is '.beads/' while .beads/issues.jsonl is tracked, so bd's auto-export git add (no -f) always fails. Likely fix: replace '.beads/' with '.beads/*' plus '!.beads/issues.jsonl' (git cannot re-include a file under an ignored directory).
2026-10-24: .gitignore fixed in the working tree (uncommitted): '.beads/' became '.beads/*' plus '!.beads/issues.jsonl'. This note is the test write for auto-export.
2026-10-25 root cause and fix: the local DB was still pre-1.0 server-mode Dolt (metadata dolt_mode server), and it came up empty on every call. Rebuilt as embedded from the JSONL (bd init --reinit-local --from-jsonl); memories restored from history/beads-backup-2026-10-25/. The push failure came from a Dolt remote this JSONL-mode repo should never have had: sessions read it as canonical mode and pushed refs/dolt/data, which a fresh clone's bd bootstrap restored (24 stale beads) ahead of the JSONL. The remote is removed, and refs/dolt/data is deleted from origin after a bundle backup.
close_reason: Fixed: embedded DB keeps changes across calls (verified with memories and bead edits in separate calls). The dolt push half no longer applies: the repo is JSONL-only, with no Dolt remote by design (AGENTS.md Sync).

title: Migrate the iOS app repo to 1.0.3
description: iOS project — check for Xcode-specific hooks (SwiftLint). Apply pilot pattern, preserve any iOS-specific quality gates.
notes:
MIGRATION SUCCEEDED on the iOS app repo (main, 1 ephemeral CC worktree, NO git remote — local-only repo).

Steps:
1. chmod 700 .beads (perms 0750 → 0700)
2. bd doctor --fix --yes (gitignore)
3. bd hooks install --force --beads (1.0.3 shim, set core.hooksPath)
4. Manually fixed core.hooksPath to relative .beads/hooks (bd had set it to absolute path — would break worktrees)
5. git rm -r --cached .githooks/ + rm -f .git/hooks/* (removed legacy locations)
6. Smoke create wj-no0c
7. Commit hook migration (07542d7) — no quality gates in original .githooks/pre-commit so commit was fast
8. Embedded migration: bd export → bd dolt stop → mv .beads/dolt aside → bd init --reinit-local --discard-remote --from-jsonl --prefix wj
9. Smoke close + commit (d5aa313)

NEW GOTCHA: bd hooks install --force --beads can leave core.hooksPath as an ABSOLUTE path (saw in doctor output), which breaks worktrees that share repo config. Manual fix: git config core.hooksPath .beads/hooks (relative).

Stats preserved: 173 issues + 12 memories.

NOT DONE:
- No remote to push to (local-only repo) — migration is complete locally
- rm -rf .beads/dolt.server-backup-20260501 (~17M, gitignored)
close_reason: whitewater hook + embedded migration verified end-to-end (no remote, local-only repo)

title: Migrate redshifted to 1.0.3
description: Redshifted has no .githooks/ — never finished prior migration. Apply pilot pattern from scratch.
notes:
MIGRATION SUCCEEDED on redshifted (main, 2 worktrees: coordinator + economy-tune both 3-4 days idle).

Steps:
1. bd doctor --fix --yes (gitignore)
2. bd hooks install --force --beads (1.0.3 shims, set core.hooksPath=.beads/hooks)
3. Manually ported quality gates (lint-staged + just check) from .git/hooks/pre-commit into .beads/hooks/pre-commit between BEADS markers and timbers section
4. rm .git/hooks/{post-checkout,post-checkout.backup,post-commit,post-merge,post-merge.backup,pre-commit,pre-push,pre-push.bd-old,prepare-commit-msg} (legacy artifacts)
5. Smoke create+commit (just check ran cleanly: shader validation, typecheck, lint, tests)
6. Embedded migration: bd export → bd dolt stop → mv .beads/dolt aside → bd init --reinit-local --discard-remote --from-jsonl --prefix redshifted (DESTROY token required)
7. Smoke close + commit + push

NEW GOTCHA: bd init --reinit-local refused without --discard-remote because the repo had a Dolt remote configured (legacy). Adding --discard-remote --destroy-token=DESTROY-redshifted let it through. The destroy-remote action is fine because we don't use Dolt remotes — sync is via git+JSONL.

Stats preserved: 2557 issues + 52 memories. project_id e14fa2bf preserved. Embedded data ~287M → smaller after compaction.

2 commits pushed: 29c645eb (embedded migration) + 4cec3549/bcdefc73 (bd init auto-commit + timbers entry).

NOT done (left for user):
- rm -rf .beads/dolt.server-backup-20260501 (~287M, gitignored)
- Worktrees coordinator/economy-tune still have stale .beads/dolt-backup-* dirs from prior migrations (gitignored, no impact)
close_reason: redshifted hooks + embedded migration verified end-to-end and pushed
